cards.text: Side effects / stop signs: The most dangerous symptoms to watch out for are diagnostic of serotonin syndrome, which can be deadly if untreated: agitation + sweating + diarrhea + tremor/clonus + fever, confusion, fast heart rate, or unstable blood pressure. Other stop signs include less dangerous symptoms (some of which are part of serotonin syndrome, but not dangerous alone) like nausea, stomach discomfort, loose stools, headache, vivid or intense dreams, insomnia, sweating, tremor, anxiety, irritability, emotional agitation, or a too-bright / hypomanic feeling.

cards.text: [Serotonin syndrome](https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007272.htm) usually comes from mixing 5-HTP casually with anything else that raises serotonin, like antidepressants or MAOIs. Reviews keep warning about the risk with 5-HTP, like [this case report](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5580516/), where a young guy on sertraline (an antidepressant) took 5-HTP with a whole pile of weight-loss and energy supplements before a workout, and ended up with serotonin syndrome so bad that surgeons had to cut open both of his legs and his forearm to relieve the pressure! Luckily he recovered. If you're doing psychedelics, avoid 5-HTP on your psychedelic days, and be especially strict around ayahuasca's [harmala MAOI chemistry](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7678905/) and around iboga or ibogaine.
